caption: The drawing depicts a simple wooden structure made of three wooden strips, colored in natural brown wood tones with visible grain detail. Two strips stand vertically, parallel to each other, and are bent to create a rounded arch at the top. The third wooden strip curves horizontally, connecting the two vertical strips at the bottom and middle, forming a looped, teardrop-shaped support. The joints where the horizontal strip meets the vertical ones are fastened with visible screws or bolts. The entire composition is centered on a plain, off-white or beige background, and there is a signature in the lower right corner reading "Rex Bush."
title: Bootjack
